biography: David Gorst, a name synonymous with aggressive, no-holds-barred racing, hails from a small industrial town in Northern England. His journey began not on a pristine track, but on the rain-slicked streets of his hometown, where he honed his car control skills in his father's beat-up Ford Fiesta. He entered the world of formal racing at the age of 19, showing immediate promise in the UK Formula Ford series. A defining moment came at Brands Hatch in 2014, when, despite starting last due to a qualifying mishap, he carved his way through the field, taking the lead on the final corner with a daring overtake that became legendary. Currently, Gorst is at the peak of his powers, piloting for MCR S2000. He is known for his relentless determination and refusal to back down, traits that have both endeared him to fans and earned him the ire of his competitors.
drivingStyle: Gorst's driving style is characterized by raw aggression and a willingness to push the car to its absolute limit. He's known for late braking maneuvers that often leave rivals scrambling, and his corner entry speeds are consistently among the highest on the grid. While this approach can sometimes lead to errors, it also allows him to extract maximum performance from his machine. He's less concerned with tire conservation, preferring to attack from start to finish, often gambling on a risky strategy to gain an advantage. In high-pressure situations, Gorst thrives, relishing the opportunity to outduel his opponents in wheel-to-wheel combat.

careerHighlight: Winning the prestigious Brands Hatch Grand Prix in 2021, after battling mechanical issues throughout the race, showcasing both his driving skill and his unwavering determination.
careerLowPoint: Suffering a season-ending injury in a high-speed crash during qualifying at Spa-Francorchamps in 2019, forcing him to watch from the sidelines as his championship hopes evaporated.
